WITH target AS (
            SELECT om.user_id, om.role, u.email
            FROM organization_memberships om
            JOIN users u ON u.id = om.user_id
            WHERE om.organization_id = $1
              AND om.user_id = $2
              AND om.status = 'INACTIVE'
              AND u.email IS NOT NULL
            FOR UPDATE
         )
         INSERT INTO organization_invitations (
            organization_id,
            email,
            invited_role,
            invitation_type,
            status,
            token_hash,
            invited_by_user_id,
            target_user_id
         )
         SELECT
            $1,
            target.email,
            target.role,
            'REACTIVATION'::invitation_type,
            'PENDING',
            $3,
            $4,
            target.user_id
         FROM target
         RETURNING id,
                   organization_id,
                   COALESCE(email, '') AS "email!",
                   invited_role::text AS "invited_role!",
                   invitation_type::text AS "invitation_type!",
                   target_user_id,
                   expires_at
